Native fixed-profile marginal generalized function-on-scalar prediction

etr_generalized_function_on_scalar_predict.Rd

Computes fixed marginal profile predictions without fitting new models or reselecting predictors. Python dataclass boundaries and full upstream model estimation parity remain open source-contract differences.

Usage

etr_generalized_function_on_scalar_predict(
  result, profiles, profile_id_column = "profile_id",
  exposure_profiles = NULL, prediction_scale = NULL, python_boundary_mode = FALSE
)

Arguments

result

Explicit native generalized function-on-scalar fitted record.

profiles

Data frame containing exactly profile identifiers and declared predictors. Numeric-text and Boolean predictor columns are converted to finite numeric values.

profile_id_column

Unique identifier column name.

exposure_profiles

Optional positive exposure vector or matrix for Poisson expected counts. Numeric text and logical values are converted before validating positivity and shape.

prediction_scale

NULL or family-compatible probability, rate or expected_count.

python_boundary_mode

Apply pandas-style string conversion to ordinary Boolean and floating-point profile identifiers. FALSE retains the native R identifier conversion.

Value

Source-shaped native prediction record containing observed-grid means, linear predictors, covariance-based pointwise standard errors, extrapolation flags, and exposure-dependent fields.
